title: Geomaster failures (operation below 90 percent)
description:
SLA of below API is less than 90% in the last one hour

Global GeoMaster dashboard link: https://jarvis-west.dc.ad.msft.net/dashboard/WAWS/Deployments/[cloud]%2520Geomaster%2520Check

RGM link: https://azureserviceinsights.trafficmanager.net/view/services/AppService/pages/GeoMaster?EventPrimaryStampName=[stampName]


TSG: Look at the failing operations below in the graph and involve the right team. You can start looking at AntaresAdminGeoEvents in wawscus cluster to see what's wrong (EventId 40006, StatusCode >= 500). Also look at the "failing calls" widget in the GeoMaster dashboard, and select the "breakdown by stamp" tab. If all the failures are isolated to a single stamp, there might be an issue on that stamp.

TSG: If a single Subscription is causing the issue, follow the steps in Block API calls on Geomaster (Web view) to block API requests temporarily.

Example routing:

  1. Recommendations -> Praveen, Faiz, Michi
  2. Certificates -> antdomaincert@microsoft.com
  3. GoDaddy related things (reseller API) -> antdomaincert@microsoft.com
  4. Default routing for control plane failures -> AntMgmt Servicing Team in ICM.

primaryKustoQuery.title: Primary kusto query
primaryKustoQuery.kustoQuery:
AntaresAdminGeoEvents
| where TIMESTAMP > ago(1h)
| where EventId == 40006 and AddressTemplate != "" and StampName !contains ".api."
// HostingEnvironment APIs frequently have pretty-name ASE name for successful requests, so don't filter those out
| where AddressTemplate has "/providers/Microsoft.Web/hostingEnvironments" or ((StampName == "" or StampName startswith "waws-prod"))
| where IsGeomasterByEventStampName(EventStampName)
| where EventStampName !in ("rgm-prod-msftinthk1")
| where StampName !has 'waws-prod-msftintch1-501' // stamp deleted on 2023-09-01
| where StampName !has 'waws-prod-msftintch1-511' // stamp deleted on 2023-09-01
| where StampName !has 'waws-prod-msftintch1-603' // stamp deleted on 2023-09-01
| where not (Operation == "NotifySiteAzureMonitorSettingUpdate" and RequestContent has "microsoft.insights/diagnosticSettings/delete") // ARM is sending requests to Insights, which in turn is sending us DELETE request for sites not found on the various stamps
| where AddressTemplate !in ('subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.Web/sites/{name}/networkFeatures/{view}', 'subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/providers/Microsoft.Web/sites/{siteName}/recommendations', 'subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.Web/sites/{siteName}/recommendations', 'subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.Web/sites/{siteName}/recommendationHistory')
| where StatusCode != 501
| join kind=leftanti (
AntaresAdminGeoEvents
| where TIMESTAMP > ago(1h)
| where EventId in (50004, 40006)
| extend SSLIssue = Details has "System.Net.Http.HttpRequestException: An error occurred while sending the request. ---> System.Net.WebException: The request was aborted: Could not create SSL/TLS secure channel."
| summarize SSLIssue = max(SSLIssue), Verb = max(Verb), AddressTemplate = max(AddressTemplate) by ActivityId
| where Verb == 'GET' and AddressTemplate == 'subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.Web/sites/{name}/extensions/{*extensionApiMethod}' and SSLIssue == true
| distinct ActivityId
) on ActivityId
| join kind=leftanti (
AntaresAdminControllerEvents
| where TIMESTAMP > ago(1h)
| where EventStampType =~ "ministamp"
| where EventId == 40001 
| where Exception startswith "System.Net.WebException: The remote name could not be resolved: "
| where Exception contains "SiteRepositoryProvider.cs:"
| distinct ActivityId
) on ActivityId
| project Verb, StatusCode, ApiType, EventId, SubscriptionId , EventStampName, Operation, AddressTemplate, SourceNamespace, TargetHostName
| summarize totalReqs = count() , failedReqs = countif(StatusCode >= 500),TotalSubs=dcount(SubscriptionId), FailingSubs=dcountif(SubscriptionId, StatusCode >= 500) by Verb, AddressTemplate, Operation, EventStampName, SourceNamespace, TargetHostName
| extend availability = 100-(failedReqs*100.0/totalReqs), impactedSubs = FailingSubs*100.0/TotalSubs
| extend isRegionalGeomaster = IsRegionalGeomasterByEventStampName(EventStampName)
| extend reqThreshold = iff(isRegionalGeomaster == true, 100, 1000)
| extend availThreshold = iff(isRegionalGeomaster == true, 80, 90)
| where totalReqs > reqThreshold and FailingSubs > 5
| where availability < availThreshold and impactedSubs > 5
| extend TargetLocation = substring(TargetHostName, 0, indexof(TargetHostName, "."))
| extend CorrelationId = iff(IsRegionalGeomasterByEventStampName(EventStampName) and TargetLocation != replace("rgm-prod-","",EventStampName), strcat("rgm-prod-", TargetLocation), EventStampName)
| extend CorrelationId=strcat(CorrelationId,"-",Operation)
| extend StampName=EventStampName
| extend Cloud=SourceNamespace
| project-away isRegionalGeomaster, reqThreshold, availThreshold, EventStampName

secondaryKustoQueries.title: Last 6 hours
secondaryKustoQueries.kustoQuery: let badRoutes=toscalar( AntaresAdminGeoEvents | where TIMESTAMP > ago(1h) | where EventId == 40006 and AddressTemplate != "" and (StampName == "" or StampName startswith "waws-prod") and StampName !contains ".api." | project Verb, StatusCode, ApiType, EventId, SubscriptionId , EventStampName, Operation, AddressTemplate | summarize totalReqs = count() , failedReqs = countif(StatusCode >= 500) by Verb, AddressTemplate, Operation, EventStampName | extend availability = 100-(failedReqs*100.0/totalReqs) | where totalReqs > 1000 | where availability < 90 | extend CorrelationId=strcat(EventStampName,"-",Operation) | where CorrelationId == "{CorrelationId}" | summarize makeset(AddressTemplate,100) ); AntaresAdminGeoEvents | where TIMESTAMP > ago(6h) | where EventId == 40006 and AddressTemplate in (badRoutes) and (StampName == "" or StampName startswith "waws-prod") and StampName !contains ".api." | summarize totalReqs = count() , failedReqs = countif(StatusCode >= 500) by AddressTemplate,bin(TIMESTAMP,5m) ,EventStampName | extend availability = 100-(failedReqs*100.0/totalReqs) | project TIMESTAMP , AddressTemplate , availability, EventStampName | evaluate pivot(AddressTemplate,sum(availability))

secondaryKustoQueries.title: Exceptions
secondaryKustoQueries.kustoQuery: let failingAddressTemplates=toscalar( AntaresAdminGeoEvents  | where TIMESTAMP > ago(1h)  | where EventId == 40006  and AddressTemplate != "" and (StampName == "" or StampName startswith "waws-prod")  and StampName !contains ".api." | project Verb, StatusCode, ApiType, EventId, SubscriptionId , EventStampName, Operation, AddressTemplate    | summarize totalReqs = count() , failedReqs = countif(StatusCode >= 500) by Verb, AddressTemplate, Operation, EventStampName      | extend availability = 100-(failedReqs*100.0/totalReqs)       | where totalReqs > 1000        | where availability < 90 | extend CorrelationId=strcat(EventStampName,"-",Operation) | where CorrelationId == "{CorrelationId}" | summarize makeset (AddressTemplate,1000)); let failingRequestIds=toscalar(AntaresAdminGeoEvents   | where TIMESTAMP > ago(1h) | where EventId == 40006 and StatusCode>=500  and AddressTemplate in (failingAddressTemplates)  | summarize makeset(ActivityId)); AntaresAdminGeoEvents  | where TIMESTAMP > ago(1h) and ActivityId in (failingRequestIds) and Level == 2 | summarize count() by Exception | order by count_ desc | take 10
